paragraphs: Abba Yose ben Yochanan: see Yose above. Of Yanuach. Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Shimon, Abba Yose, and so forth: Jerusalem Talmud, Kilayim 2:6. Keritot 6b; Shekalim, chapter 5. Tractate Derekh Eretz Zuta, chapter 9: Isi ben Yochanan in Shmuel HaKatan’s name. In Rabbi Meir’s name: Yevamot 53b.
